cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(ViewportEditExample LANGUAGES CXX)
add_executable(viewport_edit_checks viewport_edit_checks.cpp)
target_compile_features(viewport_edit_checks PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
option(VIEWPORT_EXAMPLE_ASAN "Check the original viewport edit example with AddressSanitizer" OFF)
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(viewport_edit_checks PRIVATE /utf-8 /W4 /WX)
    if(VIEWPORT_EXAMPLE_ASAN)
        target_compile_options(viewport_edit_checks PRIVATE /fsanitize=address /Zi)
        target_link_options(viewport_edit_checks PRIVATE /INCREMENTAL:NO /DEBUG)
    endif()
else()
    target_compile_options(viewport_edit_checks PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror)
    if(VIEWPORT_EXAMPLE_ASAN)
        target_compile_options(viewport_edit_checks PRIVATE -fsanitize=address,undefined)
        target_link_options(viewport_edit_checks PRIVATE -fsanitize=address,undefined)
    endif()
endif()
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME original_viewport_edit_checks COMMAND viewport_edit_checks)
